commit_subject: Add release dataset loader for the public HF dataset
license: MIT (LICENSE at the pinned commit: "Copyright (c) 2026 Audio2Tool Authors")
purpose: The published reference implementation of the Audio2Tool benchmark (arXiv:2604.22821), pinned so this repository's direct-baseline replication mirrors the paper's own protocol string-for-string instead of reconstructing it. Read-only: nothing in this clone is executed by this study, and no dependency of it is installed. The vendored copies that DO enter this repository are src/speech_aware_evidence_acquisition/reproduction/audio2tool_official/{metrics.py,parse.py}, whose identity is asserted against the blob SHAs above by tests/unit/test_audio2tool_official_scorer.py.
verification: Every entry of pinned_blobs was produced in the clone by `git rev-parse <commit>:<path>` on 2026-09-04; `git status --short` was empty at that commit.
what_is_not_pinned_here: The dataset release (RVtech/Audio2Tool on HuggingFace) and its tools_registry.csv are pinned by the umbrella docs/datasets.lock.json under the audio2tool carrier key, not by this receipt. The clone's own DEFAULT_TOOLS_CSV name (audio_benchmark/taxonomy_tools_5.backtracked.csv) is absent from the published repository; the runnable path is the config's tools_file, which the example config points at the release's tools_registry.csv -- the same 152-row file this study already carries.
